layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-px bg-white/10 border border-white/10

surfaces.card: bg-[#050505] p-8 md:p-10 hover:bg-[#111111] transition-colors duration-300 relative overflow-hidden group

motion_and_interactions.hover_state: Slight lift, border color changes to primary, text color brightens, large background number moves slightly
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Fade in and translate up from 20px, staggered for lists
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Relative overflow-hidden, with an orange tracing beam or fill animation on hover

components_instructions.header: Sticky nav, glassmorphism surface, visible navigation links on desktop, primary CTA 'Contact Experts'.
components_instructions.hero: Full height (min-h-[80vh]), geometric background with bg-black/60 overlay. Text aligned left. Giant H1 typography. Scroll down indicator.
components_instructions.at_a_glance_summary: Two massive columns. Left: 'WE DO' (positive, checkmarks, orange accents). Right: 'WE DON\'T' (negative, crosses, muted accents). High contrast typography.
components_instructions.infographic_flow: Horizontal or vertical connected steps (Collection -> Processing -> Protection -> Deletion) using glowing orange lines over the technical grid background.
components_instructions.policy_breakdown: 9-cell technical grid (1px borders between cells). Each cell represents a policy point. Large faded background numbers (01-09, text-white/5) in each card. Lucide icons (stroke-width 1.5). Very concise text.
components_instructions.mailers_section: Edge-to-edge container with solid #E57119 background and black text. Emphasize 'Total Control Over Your Inbox'.
components_instructions.footer: Massive 'IT NICHE' typography (text-[10vw]). Simple links. Darkest background (#000000).

icons.style: stroke-width 1.5, size 24 or 32, geometric and clean

hero_background.description: Abstract high-contrast 3D geometric composition featuring dark matte black surfaces and glowing warm orange spherical and cubic elements

infographic_background.description: Minimalist infographic background featuring thin warm orange grid lines on a rich matte black background
infographic_background.placement: Background for the 'How we handle your data' flow section

policy_points.title: Data Sharing
policy_points.text: We do not rent, sell, or share personal info except for service delivery with your permission.

policy_points.title: Trusted Partners
policy_points.text: We work with trusted partners under strict confidentiality agreements.

policy_points.title: Legal Compliance
policy_points.text: We comply with subpoenas, court orders, and legal processes.

policy_points.title: Fraud Prevention
policy_points.text: Information is shared only to prevent illegal activities, fraud, or threats.

policy_points.title: Business Transfer
policy_points.text: Data transferred only in the event of an acquisition or merger.

policy_points.title: User Information
policy_points.text: Your name and email are used solely as intended. You can opt out anytime.

policy_points.title: IP Addresses
policy_points.text: Used purely for diagnostics. Never linked to your personal identity.

policy_points.title: Third-Party Links
policy_points.text: We are not responsible for the privacy practices of external third-party sites.

policy_points.title: Mailers & Comms
policy_points.text: Promotional emails contain clear unsubscribe links for total control.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast for text over backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app using Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Install Google Fonts 'Lato' (Weights: 300, 400, 900). Use font-black for headings and font-light for body.
Implement the 'Technical Grid' layout for the 9 policy points: a grid container with gap-px and bg-white/10, where child cards have bg-[#050505]. This perfectly creates 1px borders between all cards.
Do NOT use rounded corners on the policy cards to match the Swiss Brutalist aesthetic.
Use framer-motion for staggering the entrance of the cards and infographic flow elements.
The Hero section background image must have a bg-black/60 overlay applied via an absolute positioning or background-blend-mode.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
